values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/kingstonlake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Kingston Lake State Forest Campground, Alger: 16 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch on Kingston Lake (no-wake rules); carry-in access about 10 yards from the parking area or straight from some sites; picnic area with two tables on the south side.

values.note: 16 'tent and small trailer sites' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/kingstonlake ('This rustic campground offers 16 tent and small trailer sites, almost entirely surrounded by water'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (16 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground almost entirely surrounded by Kingston Lake, on the northern edge of the Kingston Plains, 18.8 mi SW of Grand Marais via H-58 (Alger County); managed by Indian Lake State Park. The closest state forest campground to Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore; the Fox River Pathway runs four miles to Lake Superior, and ORVs and snowmobiles may run to the trails (ORV Trail 8 is adjacent). Sites are tight: some fit a 23-ft rig but larger rigs struggle (a reviewer's 18-ft fit fine). --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 16 tent/small-trailer sites (confirmed), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Season (open all year, roads not plowed) already manual and matches the page. Boat launch, carry-in access, picnic area. Not equestrian. Note trimmed of field restatements.
